links.outcome: Sensitivity and specificity of AI pipeline in ideal-world versus real-world conditions
links.effect: Real-world full pipeline: sensitivity 0.76, AUC-ROC 0.90, accuracy 0.81; ideal-world: sensitivity 0.92, specificity 0.42, F1 0.84.
links.quote: In the ideal-world analysis, sensitivity reached 0.92, the F1-score was 0.84, and specificity was 0.42.

screen.reason: The study describes developing and evaluating an offline mobile AI tool for cutaneous leishmaniasis triage on clinical photographs, but it evaluates diagnostic performance rather than testing a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
